AI Agent: B2B Message Converter - Enrich Workflow Features Along with Upload and Download Capabilities
You can use the B2B Message Converter AI agent to streamline the conversion of B2B messages such as shipments from a Fusion Application REST resource into industry-standard formats. Shipments are currently supported in OAGIS 10.1.
Users can perform a complete sequence of messaging conversion steps within the agent, including uploading and downloading mapping files.
All actions, ranging from entering instructions and uploading mapping files, to initiating conversions and downloading outputs are performed through the AI Agent Studio chat interface.

Sample Prompts

  • Convert Shipment Number 67891 to OAGIS
Once the request is successfully completed, you have the option to download documents and access the message definition and message log for further review.
Download and View Options

Input Document (InputDocument): The content is provided in standard JSON format specifically sourced from an Oracle Fusion REST API response.

Outbound Document (OutputDocument): This file includes the transformed message in OAGIS format.

Node and Node Types

Node NameNode TypeDescription
Process User InputLLMThis LLM is parsing a user's prompt to extract relevant document details, validating input, identifying required formats, and managing errors.
Verify User InputIF conditionalThis condition checks for input errors.
The agent leverages message definitions to automate and standardize message transformations, while the B2B Messages page logs the results of each conversion.

Steps to enable and configure

You can use AI Agent Studio to use or copy a preconfigured agent template to create Agents for your business processes. To automatically add a suffix to all artifacts in your agent team, you can Copy Template instead of Use Template. When you copy a template, you're directly taken to the agent team canvas where you can edit the agent team settings, agents, tools, and topics. The Use Template option takes you through a step-by-step process for configuring each artifact in the agent team.

Agent Template: B2B Message Converter

Tips and considerations

  • In this update, the B2B Message Converter AI agent supports the Advance Ship Notice document type.
  • The prompt needs to include both the document type and the corresponding document number.

Access requirements

To access the Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications and manage SCM AI agents, users must be assigned a configured job role that contains these duty roles:
  • SCM Intelligent Agent Management Duty (ORA_RCS_SCM_AI_AGENT_MANAGEMENT_DUTY)
  • Fai Genai Agent SCM Administrator Duty (ORA_DR_FAI_GENERATIVE_AI_AGENT_SCM_ADMINISTRATOR_DUTY)
